dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Ah, so you're the rumored Traveler, our hero and savior! Thanks to you, we can finally get back to mining and earning a living.

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: I mean, it just feels like I'm missing a little something in my day when Tu's not boasting away somewhere. Nor do I really know what he's been pondering recently, anyway.
